name: Random Island
changelog: NEW: "Mining" enchantment (鎸栨帢) - only on pickaxes, breaks ANY block in a fixed 5s ignoring hardness (even bedrock), dropped in most reward/starter chests (miningBookChance). Also: "uniform" toggle (islandUniform); all-blocks mode (useAllBlocks) and all-items mode (useAllItems) include other mods; configurable starter chest; better default loot. Commands: interval / transform / weight / allblocks / allitems / uniform / reset / help.
